title: A2I agent output (a2i-italic-marker)
description: Backfills italic_terms onto an A2 page already read before that field existed. Identical in shape to schemas/A2B.json with bold_terms renamed to italic_terms. Never edits the original A2 output -- this is a separate, additive file keyed by the same page id.

n.description: Must match a paragraph/box/list block's own `n` in the real A2 output for this page.

italic_terms.description: Every substring of that block's `text` that prints in italic (and not bold) in the source image, copied character-for-character, in reading order, each once. Empty array when nothing in the block is italic.
